summary: A dependable December garden outing in Mae Hia, with international themed gardens, plant houses and the ornate Ho Kham Luang royal pavilion. Treat this as a year-round attraction enjoyed in the cool season; a specific December 2026 flower-festival programme has not yet been verified.
whyGo: Explore large landscaped grounds and contrasting Thai and international garden designs.
Combine architectural photography at Ho Kham Luang with orchids, flower displays and quieter garden walks.
bestFor: Families wanting a relaxed half-day outdoors
skipIf: You want a compact attraction within walking distance of the Old City.
You need guaranteed particular flowers or a confirmed evening festival programme.
duration: Allow 2–4 hours as a planning estimate; selective visits using the sightseeing vehicle can be shorter.
cost: Official admission: foreign adults THB 200; foreign children 100–140 cm THB 150; children under 100 cm free. Thai adult/child rates are THB 100/70. A November 2025 official service tariff lists the sightseeing electric vehicle free, bicycles THB 60–100 per day and golf carts THB 1,000 per hour; reconfirm rental prices. Transport and food extra.
hours: Official standard hours are daily 08:00–18:00. Do not assume evening opening for December 2026.
bestTime: Arrive at 08:00 for cooler walking conditions, or visit mid-afternoon. The park recommends 08:00–10:00 and 15:00–18:00 for photography.
gettingThere: Mae Hia, southwest of central Chiang Mai. Use a taxi, ride-hailing car or hired driver; allow roughly 25–40 minutes from the Old City as a traffic-dependent planning estimate. Arrange the return journey. TAT gives driving approaches via Canal Road/Route 121 or Chiang Mai–Hang Dong Road/Route 108.
booking: Plan to buy ordinary admission on arrival; advance purchase is not established as necessary. Check the official website shortly before travelling for event tickets, closures and operating changes.
accessibility: The extensive site means considerable distances between displays. A sightseeing electric vehicle can reduce walking, but wheelchair boarding, accessible toilets and step-free access throughout Ho Kham Luang were not verified. Ask the park about your specific requirements before visiting.
practicalTips: Choose a few garden zones rather than trying to cover the whole park.
Bring water, sun protection and comfortable shoes; cooler-season afternoons can still feel hot.
Check the latest park map and vehicle arrangements at entry.
The park FAQ lists Royal Project Kitchen for meals; confirm its hours on the day.
decemberNotes: The park has announced preparations for Flora Festival 2026, including temporary works in August–September 2026, but this does not establish December dates or a programme. Listings for Flora Festival 2025 covering late 2025 and early 2026 are historical and cannot confirm December 2026 activities. The gardens remain a viable standard-hours seasonal outing.
uncertainties: December 2026 festival dates, special displays, evening opening and event-specific prices remain unverified.
Rental prices, temporary garden closures and detailed wheelchair access need reconfirmation.
